lines.ref:
Struggled with confidence
thoughout dental school

My parents took me to
several doctors

made plans to
break my jaws

I was scared but put on
a brave face

And now we have a
thriving practice

An amazing team focused
on growth

Helping many patients
smile their best

And we're only just
getting started!

Follow to get
your dream smile
#drjessyeo.ortho

audit.notes: This format relies fundamentally on highly specific, personal archival artifacts: childhood/adolescent photos of facial insecurity, medical/hospital recovery photos, dental school graduation, and clinical footage inside an orthodontic practice. Generic lifestyle b-roll cannot substitute for an authentic biographical transformation story.
audit.summary: An orthodontist shares her personal transformation story—from childhood insecurity and double jaw surgery to graduating dental school and founding her own thriving orthodontic clinic.
